description: Source code for the 'mod_expire' plugin of the lighttpd web server, responsible for setting HTTP cache headers like Cache-Control and Expires based on configuration and request context.

methods.name: mod_expire_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure for the expire module.

methods.name: mod_expire_free
methods.description: Frees resources allocated by the plugin.

methods.name: mod_expire_get_offset
methods.description: Parses time offset strings like 'access 3 months' into seconds.

methods.name: mod_expire_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_expire_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration to request-specific plugin config.

methods.name: mod_expire_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the plugin.

methods.name: mod_expire_set_header
methods.description: Sets Cache-Control or Expires headers based on offset.

methods.name: mod_expire_handler
methods.description: Main handler to add caching headers to HTTP responses.

methods.name: mod_expire_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and registers its functions with lighttpd.
